The Problem

Coding with AI Today

  • Coding with AI means your laptop has to stay on
  • On a personal laptop, you keep approving permissions
  • You already pay for Claude, so no Linear or Cursor subscription on top
01

What is it?

What is it?

Requirement

User story

As a effective student developer, I want to assign tasks to my agent without my laptop on, so that I can go and watch a movie.

Acceptance criteria

  • I can shut the lid mid-task and the agent carries on
  • I can safely turn on bypass permissions without risking my files
  • By the time the credits roll, the result is waiting for my review
  • The ticket status updates on its own as the agent works
What is it?

Docker Sandbox

  • Isolated environment: Claude only sees what you give it
  • But it still stops when the laptop sleeps
What is it?

Meet Linear

  • Minimalist by design: fast and focused, without the clutter of Jira-style tools
  • Trusted by teams like OpenAI, Vercel, Ramp and Coinbase
  • Developer friendly: GitHub, Slack and an API, plus custom apps and agents
What is it?

Your Own Agent in Linear

  • No extra SaaS subscription, no Claude API costs
  • Your own agent runs on your Claude subscription, connected through Linear’s OAuth gateway
  • Assign a ticket: it plans, builds, tests, verifies and updates the status
What is it?

Ticket to PR

  1. AC & user story written
  2. Reads ticket, writes code
  3. PR opened
  4. Ticket status updated

04

Where does it break?

Where does it break?

Output Quality Depends
on the Ticket

The issue is the agent’s entire “prompt”

A vague ticket will lead to a hallucination and guessing

More time must be spent on writing more detailed tickets

Where does it break?

Reviewing Becomes
the Bottleneck

The agent opens PRs on its own, but a human still has to review and merge every one

More tickets delegated means more PRs in the queue: the work moves from writing code to reviewing it

Agent code can look right and still be wrong, so check it against the ticket's acceptance criteria

Where does it break?

Limited Environment

Our Railway setup has no Docker, so the agent cannot run the app or a database

On fly.io or AWS ECS, Docker-in-Docker lets the agent spin up your whole stack, database included

Add Playwright and it can check the UI itself and attach screenshots

Your options

Pick the Right Fit

Build it yourself and integrate your own agent with Linear

Use Cursor, which has a native Linear integration

Skip the build: Claude Code cloud sessions with Linear MCP enabled
